doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: A disliked teacher and the move to California
summary: She had a Kansas City teacher she cancelled after a few lessons; her grandmother and aunts moved to California in 1937 and she and her mother followed by train months later.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: [Liston had a teacher in Kansas City that she didn’t like.]
I told my mother to cancel him. So we didn’t stay – two or three lessons, that was all. [She cannot recall the reasons why.]
In 1937 all of a sudden the family moved to California. You and your mom?
No. My mom and me stayed over, and my grandma and my aunties moved out here. Maybe four or five months later, we came out. I don’t really know the exact times.
[remembers only that it was a train ride.]
